scripts.format: npm --prefix frontend run format && npx prettier --write README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md docs/README.md
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix frontend run format:check && npx prettier --check README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md docs/README.md
scripts.check:frontend: npm test && npm run format:check && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo doc --no-deps && cargo test
scripts.check:all: npm run check:frontend && npm run check:rust
scripts.generate:licences: cargo about generate about.hbs -o ./src/assets/licences.html && npx license-checker-rseidelsohn --start ./frontend --json --out ./src/assets/npm-licences.json && node scripts/relativise-npm-licences.mjs ./src/assets/npm-licences.json
